title: Particle Flipbook blend weight is narrowed from float to half
trigger: _FLIPBOOKBLENDING_ON, helper flag false, interpolated TEXCOORD3.x weight not exactly representable in binary16
before: float3 blendUv.z receives float4 varying.w directly
after: streamWeight converts float -> half -> float before lerp
risk: Potential output delta on actual 16-bit/min16 targets; current desktop parity does not prove this path exact. ShaderLab type contract changed even when half maps float.
smallest_fix: Return streamWeight directly in the non-helper arm.

title: Fresnel dot narrows interpolated normal before dot
trigger: _FRESNEL, interpolation gives float normal not binary16-representable, actual half/min16 shader target
before: half3 fresnelDir and float3 normal are dotted, then assigned half dotNV
after: incoming float normal converts to half3 function argument before dot
risk: Remap/pow/Fresnel alpha/RGB can differ. Keep the original normal precision and assignment boundary.
smallest_fix: Change normalWS argument to float3 in both implementation and forward declaration.

title: Normal-map transformed result now passes through half3 output
trigger: Only configurations with real3=float3 but native/minimum 16-bit half semantics; not an extra narrowing when real3 already half3
before: normalize(URP TransformTangentToWorld(...)) assigned directly to float3 varying
after: normalize result assigned to half3 out and half3 local before float3 varying
risk: URP17.3 return type is real3. Mobile/unified default already real=half; REAL_IS_HALF=0/native-half combination is the unresolved precision case.
smallest_fix: Use float3 output and local, or exactly preserve real3 output/local; retain existing normalize invocation.

title: Fresnel constant 1.01 is spelled 1.01h
risk: Suffix handling is compiler dependent; no current-target output delta established. Literal spelling is unnecessary for extraction and weakens strict source precision proof.

title: Two hidden material Properties added
before: No ShaderLab Property declarations, but both HLSL variables already in UnityPerMaterial
after: Vector default (0,0,0,0), Float default 0; new property count 443 versus 441

smallest_fix: Either restore property surface if user requires literal sameness, or explicitly document/approve this contract addition.

title: 31 uniforms appended to UnityPerMaterial
before: _VATTex_TexelSize outside buffer; 30 Houdini float uniforms extern/outside material CBUFFER
after: All 31 in material CBUFFER; old declarations retained as exact prefix; Houdini extern disabled under NBSHADER_INPUT

smallest_fix: Treat as explicit allowed batching/binding fix, or restore layout when literal invariance is required.

title: Additional vertex-light/fog path differs from main
before: InitializeInputData accesses nonexistent fogFactorAndVertexLight; non-SixWay includes SixWay material body containing undeclared surfaceData reference
after: Reads actual fog positionWS.w and vertexLight; non-SixWay includes only Half-Lambert section

title: NBPostProcessing camera shake and disable lifecycle changed
